mod.name: Piano Roll: RESS-SQ
mod.author: Ressa
mod.description: A sixteenth-note step sequencer for the Detail Editor: per-row mute, solo, fold, rename, a GEN button for the marked rows and RND/CLR scope, follow-playhead, page scrolling, a MIDI key readout, and per-step velocity, offset, length, repeat, pitch and chance.
